title: Birdex Bird Sightings
summary: UK bird observations contributed through the Birdex mobile app; records are generalized to 1 km and published anonymously with stable occurrence UUIDs and taxon identifiers. Registered in GBIF September 15, 2026.
semantic_integrity: Citizen observations are not equivalent to standardized surveys. Consent withdrawal and deletion can cause records to disappear from regenerated releases; absence from a later release must not be interpreted as biological absence.

title: iNaturalist Research-grade Observations — September 2026 release
summary: Research-grade iNaturalist observations through September 7, 2026, published as a GBIF occurrence archive. The release preserves a versioned snapshot rather than a timeless database state.
semantic_integrity: Research-grade is a platform quality designation, not a universal guarantee of taxonomic or spatial correctness. Preserve the release date and quality criteria with any downstream analysis.

title: Neogene–Quaternary western Pacific teleost otolith dataset
summary: 4,893 newly collected fossil otoliths from the Dahan River section in northern Taiwan, spanning approximately eight million years from the Late Miocene to the Quaternary, with taxonomic and stratigraphic distributions.
semantic_integrity: The dataset supports assemblage and turnover analyses; interpretive claims about community restructuring remain downstream analyses rather than raw specimen evidence.

title: Gasteroid fungi collection of Nature Research Centre (BILAS)
summary: Digitized records for 67 species in 20 genera of gasteroid fungi preserved in the BILAS herbarium in Lithuania, including historical collecting material and specimens associated with a major 1982 Lithuanian treatment.
semantic_integrity: Historical taxonomic names and the 1982 treatment should remain linked to modern accepted names rather than silently replacing the original specimen labels.

title: NMNH Paleobiology Specimen Records (USNM)
summary: Public Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History paleobiology records covering accessioned fossil invertebrates, vertebrates and plants, including more than 139,000 paleobiological type specimen records. Publication updated September 2, 2026.
semantic_integrity: Collection metadata is distinct from the physical specimens and from later taxonomic interpretations. Type-specimen status is a provenance attribute, not a claim about biological importance.

title: NMNH Extant Specimen Records (USNM)
summary: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History accessioned specimen and observation records across botany, entomology, invertebrate zoology, and vertebrate zoology, including more than 270,000 primary type specimen records.
semantic_integrity: Preserve original collection identifiers, determinations, and type status separately from current taxonomic names. A current name should not overwrite historical determinations.

title: University of Alabama Herbarium
summary: Digitized specimen data from the University of Alabama Herbarium, including vascular plants, bryophytes, algae, lichens and fungi. The collection includes approximately 68,603 vascular plant specimens and additional cryptogam holdings; digitization is ongoing.
source_registry: GBIF/University of Alabama Biodiversity and Systematics
semantic_integrity: Because digitization is ongoing, absence from the current public dataset is not evidence that a specimen does not exist. Track release snapshots over time.

title: Herbarium GB, University of Gothenburg
summary: University of Gothenburg herbarium records covering roughly one million dried specimens, including major Nordic, Middle Eastern, Mediterranean and tropical South American collections and long-running Flora of Ecuador research material.
semantic_integrity: The geographic and research-project history is provenance context; it should not be conflated with completeness of regional flora sampling.

title: Naturalis Biodiversity Center — Paleontology
summary: Naturalis Biodiversity Center's integrated paleontology collection record, incorporating previously published subcollections while retiring/deactivating some older separate datasets. The collection descends from former Dutch national geology and natural-history museums.
semantic_integrity: This is an explicit migration/consolidation case: deactivated subcollection identifiers must remain preserved as historical aliases rather than being treated as deleted evidence.

title: University of California Museum of Paleontology collection data
summary: UC Museum of Paleontology collection data covering microfossils, paleobotany, vertebrate and invertebrate paleontology and broader biological collections, with a September 14, 2026 publication update.
semantic_integrity: Museum collection scope should be distinguished from the subset of specimens digitized or externally published at any given time.
